mapper.sql: mp.menu_permission_id AS "menuPermissionId", mp.subject_type AS "subjectType", mp.subject_id AS "subjectId", mp.menu_id AS "menuId", major.menu_name AS "majorMenuName", middle.menu_name AS "middleMenuName", m.menu_name AS "screenName", mp.access_allowed AS "accessAllowed"
FROM menu_permission mp JOIN menu m ON m.menu_id = mp.menu_id LEFT JOIN menu middle ON middle.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN menu major ON major.menu_id = middle.parent_menu_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM menu WHERE menu_id = #{menuId})

SELECT CASE WHEN #{subjectType} = 'ROLE' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM role WHERE role_code = #{subjectId}) WHEN #{subjectType} = 'ORGANIZATION' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization WHERE organization_id = #{subjectId}) WHEN #{subjectType} = 'USER' THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM user_account WHERE user_id = #{subjectId}) ELSE false END
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu_permission (menu_permission_id, subject_type, subject_id, menu_id, access_allowed, status) VALUES (#{menuPermissionId}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{menuId}, #{accessAllowed}, 'ACTIVE') ON CONFLICT (subject_type, subject_id, menu_id) DO UPDATE SET access_allowed = EXCLUDED.access_allowed, status = 'ACTIVE', updated_at = current_timestamp
